finding.description: A syntactically valid unrelated recovered hash was saved before exact-call verification; the resulting pending UI could not correct it.
fixed_behaviors: Verify receipt identity, exact calldata and zero value before preserving a candidate hash
Keep original intent/hash on mismatch, absent receipt, network failure, stale record or unmount
Allow a verified replacement without requesting or signing any new transaction
Use the origin-scoped Web Lock and durable-record checks for candidate replacement and human no-send acknowledgment

limitations: Local callback tests isolate storage, locks and RPC; saved real payloads are not a fresh human-wallet execution.
Earlier native wallet proofs describe their explicitly pinned previous frontend; unchanged send/check/persist/connect/dismiss callbacks are separately compared.
